title: Budget Savant: Prefetch Heuristics + Quant Tier Manager
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: Large tenants with bursty tail traffic waste tokens and GPU cycles during cold KV-cache windows. Goal: introduce a tenant-scoped prefilling heuristic and a quantization-tier manager that automatically picks safe, cost-effective quant profiles per workload bucket while preserving latency SLOs. Design summary: 1) Budget Savant engine: observes recent per-tenant token/latency/cold-start patterns and computes a prefilling budget and prefetch TTL heuristics; 2) Quant Tier Manager: uses a lightweight regret-minimization loop that recommends quantization tier (fp16, int8, or hybrid 4-bit) per model/tenant cohort and ties recommendations to unit-econ delta thresholds; 3) Safe-fallbacks: runtime enforces a safe mode that uses a conservative profile when tail latency deviates beyond configured hysteresis. This PR implements the controller, telemetry hooks, CLI flags for dry-run, and a migration path for existing tenant defaults.

backout_and_revert_steps: Use redwoodctl econ prefill revert --tenant <id> to instant-revert tenant defaults

release_notes: Introduce 'Budget Savant' tenant prefetch heuristics and a Quant Tier Manager that recommends safe quantization profiles to reduce per-token cost without increasing tail latency. Opt-in dry-run and staged rollout. See docs/tenants/prefill-and-quant.md for details.
additional_notes: This PR focuses on automation and safe defaults; it deliberately does not alter global routing or model selection logic. Future follow-ups: A/B evaluation harness that ties model-quality deltas to cost savings and an autoscaler hook that consumes budget_savant outputs for burst capacity decisions.
